question.text: A polished metal plate with a rough black spot on it is heated to about <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1400</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> and quickly taken to a dark room. The spot will appear

solution.text: On heating, black spot absorbs maximum radiation. Therefore, when plate is taken to a dark room the spot will emit more radiations than the rest of the plate. Hence, it will appear brighter than the plate.
